PLAYER_NAME.description: This is automatically set from your game character. The player name is retrieved from Fallout when you load a save or start a new game. This field cannot be manually edited.

AUTOMATIC_DATABASE_BACKUPS.description: Automatically create database backups every time the server starts up. Keeps a maximum of 5 backups, automatically deleting the oldest when the limit is reached.

LOCK_PROFILE.description: When enabled, this profile will be skipped when using 'Copy to All Profiles' functionality. It will also not be deleted when you Delete All Character Profiles. Can not be toggled for the default profile.

AUTO_LOCK_PROFILE.description: When enabled, saving an NPC profile in SYNTH NPC page automatically locks it to prevent history updates from overwriting manual edits.

AUTOFILL_CUSTOM_PROFILES.description: When enabled, imported custom NPCs with blank AI profile fields will be marked for automatic AI profile backfill once they have enough usable dialogue history.

AUTOFILL_CUSTOM_PROFILES_TRIGGER.description: Number of usable AI profile events required before a blank custom NPC is auto-filled. Range: 10-100.

SYNTH_NAME.description:
NPC Name. MUST MATCH their Fallout in-game NPC name!
If you are in the default profile YOU MUST leave it as The Narrator!
You can change profiles by clicking the blue button in the top left.

PROMPT_HEAD.description: System Prompt. Defines the rules of the roleplay.

PLAYER_SPEECH_STYLE.description: Instructions for how the player character speaks and communicates. This will be used as context when rewriting player dialogue.

PROMPT_TIMESTAMP.description: Add rough timestamp subdividers to event context (e.g., 'Moments Ago', 'A while ago') to help the AI NPCs understand when events happend.

COMPACT_NPC_CONTEXT_HISTORY.description: Use compact text instead of separate messages for prior NPC conversation history. Does not affect the Narrator.

SHORT_TERM_MEMORY_IN_COMPACT_CHAT.description: Keeps short term memory summaries in the prompt while Compact NPC Context History is on. Only affects profiles with Short Term Memory enabled. Turn off to keep the compact prompt smaller.

PROMPT_HEAD_MARKDOWN_ENABLED.description: Use Markdown headings instead of XML tags for all prompt sections.

PROMPT_CONTEXT_OPTIONS.description: Controls which XML-like prompt context sections are included in the final system prompt sent to the LLM. Managed from Global Settings.

SYNTH_BACKGROUND.description:
NPC Background.
Detailed history, origins, and past experiences that shaped this character.

SYNTH_PERSONALITY.description:
NPC Personality Traits.
Detailed character traits, behavioral patterns, and psychological characteristics.

SYNTH_APPEARANCE.description:
NPC Physical Appearance.
Detailed description of physical features. Do not include clothing or equipment.

SYNTH_OCCUPATION.description:
NPC Occupation & Role.
Current job, profession, duties, and position in society or organizations.

SYNTH_SKILLS.description:
NPC Skills & Abilities.
Special talents, combat abilities, technical knowledge, survival skills, and areas of expertise.

SYNTH_SPEECHSTYLE.description:
NPC Speech Style.
How this character speaks, including vocabulary, accent, mannerisms, and communication patterns.

SYNTH_GOALS.description:
NPC Goals & Aspirations.
Long-term objectives, personal ambitions, and life goals that drive this character.

DYNAMIC_PROFILE.description: Will automatically update selected profile fields from the timer set in the MCM menu. Can adjust the prompts used by editing individual DYNAMIC_PROMPT_* fields. Requires CONNECTOR_DIARY to be configured.

DYNAMIC_PROFILE_FIELDS.description: Only recommend selecting 1-3 fields! Select which extended profile fields should be dynamically updated from ingame Dynamic Profile Timer.

DIARY_COOLDOWN.description: Cooldown period in seconds between diary entries to prevent spam. Each NPC has their own independent cooldown timer.

AUTO_DIARY_ENABLED.description: Automatically generate diary entries when NPCs are nearby during sleep events. NPCs using this profile will have auto diary enabled by default.

AUTO_DIARY_WAIT_ENABLED.description: When Auto Diary is enabled, this controls whether diary entries are created during wait events. If disabled, auto diary will only trigger on sleep events.

WORLDKNOWLEDGE_INFINIUM.description: Enable World Knowledge topic extraction and prompt injection.

WORLDKNOWLEDGE_RESULT_LIMIT.description: Maximum grounded World Knowledge articles included in one prompt.

RACE_WORLDKNOWLEDGE.description: Include lore that matches the active NPC race or species.

FACTION_WORLDKNOWLEDGE.description: Include lore that matches the active NPC faction context.

WORLDKNOWLEDGE_EXTRACTOR_FALLBACK.description: Allow the configured extractor connector to resolve explicit lore requests that deterministic retrieval cannot ground.

WORLDKNOWLEDGE_EXTRACTOR_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for the optional World Knowledge extractor fallback.

LOCATION_WORLDKNOWLEDGE.description: Force World Knowledge for the current Fallout location and worldspace into NPC prompts when matching articles exist.

WORLDKNOWLEDGE_CUSTOM.description: Use custom LLM for WorldKnowledge topic extraction instead of MiniMe T5. Allows for custom prompt via Prompts Manager.

WORLDKNOWLEDGE.description: Knowledge Classes assigned to the NPC. Effects what articles they can access in the WorldKnowledge database. If you want to add more make sure they are comma separated. Recommend to leave as default.

WORLDKNOWLEDGE_AMOUNT.description: Max extracted world knowledge topics per turn.

RECHAT_H.description:
Rechat Rounds. Higher values will increase the amount of times AI NPC's will go back-and-forth during a conversation.
1 = 1 Round | 2 = 2 Rounds | 3 = 3 Rounds etc

RECHAT_P.description:
Rechat Probability. Chance that an AI NPC will continue an ongoing conversation.
0 = Never | 50 = 50% | 100 = Always

RECHAT_ALLOW_ACTIONS.description: Allow AI NPCs to trigger actions between eachother during Rechat. This can cause some chaos...

RECHAT_MODE.description: Controls how server-side rechat picks the next responder. Tight = listener-only, Conversational = prefers the current partner, Group = lets nearby NPCs rotate into the exchange, Random = picks one of the other modes at the start of each rechat chain.

ENFORCE_STRICT_RECHAT_RESPONSE.description: If enabled, the NPC chosen for a rechat turn must respond directly to the previous speaker and set the listener to that speaker.

BORED_EVENT.description:
Bored Event Probability. Chance of an AI NPC starting a random conversation every couple of minutes.
0 = Never | 50 = 50% | 100 = Always

BORED_EVENT_SERVERSIDE.description: Smart Bored Events. Will use the director to generate dynamic bored event topics. It is slower but topics will improve the quality of bored event topics.

CONTEXT_HISTORY.description:
Amount of context history (dialogue and events) that will be sent to LLM. Improves short term memory.
Higher Context = more tokens used and slower response time.
We recommend you do not go over 100

CONTEXT_HISTORY_DIARY.description:
Amount of context history (dialogue and events) that will be sent to LLM specifically for diary entries.
If set to 0, will use the regular CONTEXT_HISTORY value instead.

CONTEXT_HISTORY_DYNAMIC_PROFILE.description:
Amount of context history (dialogue and events) that will be sent to LLM specifically for dynamic profile updates.
If set to 0, will use the regular CONTEXT_HISTORY value instead.

ALIVE_MESSAGE.description: Whether the I am alive.. response will trigger whenever you activate an AI NPC.

QUEST_COMMENT.description: Will trigger AI (NPCs and Narrator) to talk about new objectives in your current active quest. Will trigger a lot of events on a new character, so leave disabled until you complete the tutorial!

QUEST_COMMENT_CHANCE.description: Chance that an AI Quest Comment will happen every time a quest updates.

QUEST_COMMENT_COOLDOWN.description: Minimum time in minutes between quest comments. Default: 3 minutes

RPG_COMMENTS.description: Pick which comments you want a chance to trigger when one of these Fallout ingame events happens.

LOCATION_BLACKLIST.description: Comma-separated list of location names to exclude from Points of Interest context (e.g. 'Glowing Sea, Mass Fusion Building').

ITEM_BLACKLIST.description: Comma-separated list of item/armor names to exclude from dynamic context (e.g. '9mm Pistol, Leather Armor, Stimpak').

SHORTER_NEARBY_ITEM_LIST.description: Group duplicate nearby ground items into one counted entry. When enabled, context shows one line per unique nearby item plus a single representative RefID in the item descriptions block.

EVENT_TYPE_FILTER.description: Comma-separated list of event types to exclude from context generation (e.g. 'death, itemfound, chat').

GROUND_ITEMS_DESCRIPTIONS_ONLY.description: Only show nearby ground items in context that have descriptions in the description manager.

INVENTORY_ITEMS_DESCRIPTIONS_ONLY.description: Only show inventory items in context that have descriptions in the description manager.

HIDE_AMBIENT_COMBAT.description: Hide ambient NPC-to-NPC combat deaths from context during requests. Only player, current actor, and companion/party deaths or kills will be shown.

SYNTH_ANIMATIONS.description: Will issue animations for the NPC to play

LANG_LLM_XTTS.description: XTTS Only! Will offer a language field to LLM, and will try match to XTTSv2 language.

MAX_WORDS_LIMIT.description: Attempt to enforce a word limit for AI's responses. Leave as 0 to have no limit.

JSON_DIALOGUE_FORMAT_REORDER.description: Reorders properties in the output JSON schema. AI generates an action first, then a dialogue comment. Some users report this improves actions performance.

EMOTEMOODS.description: Default list of moods passed to LLM (comma separated). Can be overridden per-NPC in SYNTH NPCs. Some moods will trigger animations if enabled.

ENFORCE_ACTIONS_PROMPT.description: Adds a prompt to enforce use of actions

SUMMARY_PROMPT.description: Custom instructions added when generating summaries for memories. You can adjust max tokens by changing MAX_TOKENS_MEMORY for the SUMMARY connector you are using.

DYNAMIC_PROMPT_PERSONALITY.description: Instructions for updating NPC personality traits based on recent events and interactions.

DYNAMIC_PROMPT_OCCUPATION.description: Instructions for updating NPC occupation and role based on story progression and events.

DYNAMIC_PROMPT_SKILLS.description: Instructions for updating NPC skills and abilities based on experiences and training.

DYNAMIC_PROMPT_SPEECHSTYLE.description: Instructions for updating NPC speech patterns and communication style based on interactions.

DYNAMIC_PROMPT_GOALS.description: Instructions for updating NPC goals and aspirations based on story developments and achievements.

DIARY_PROMPT.description: Instructions for generating diary entries. You can adjust max tokens by changing MAX_TOKENS_MEMORY for the DIARY connector you are using.

CONNECTORS.description:
AI Service(s) to be used for most AI features.
Select the JSON-capable service(s) you have configured for AI/LLM Connectors below.

Make sure to click the Current AI Service button at the top of the page if you change connectors!

CONNECTORS_DIARY.description:
JSON connector used for diary-related generation (manual diary, auto-diary, and dynamic profile updates).

This is separate from long-term memory recall and memory summary compaction.

CORE_CONNECTOR_DIRECTOR.description: Connector used for Director mode. Recommend to use a Powerful LLM.

CORE_CONNECTOR_PLAYER.description: Connector used for player re-speech. Recommend to use a very Fast LLM.

CORE_CONNECTOR_SUMMARY.description: Connector used for generating and compacting memory summaries that power long-term memory recall. Recommend using a smaller LLM.

CORE_CONNECTOR_MEDIUMTERM.description: Connector used to generate longer memories summaries after every 10 memory summaries. Can be enabled in SYNTH NPC page. Recommend to user a smaller LLM.

CORE_CONNECTOR_SCENECLASSIFIER.description: Connector used to classify recent scene tone/genre for post-request ambient cues. Recommend using a very fast small LLM.

SCENE_CLASSIFIER_ENABLED.description: Enable the Scene Classifier. When enabled, SYNTH runs a small post-request genre/tone classification pass for ambient scene cues. Requires CORE_CONNECTOR_SCENECLASSIFIER or a valid fallback connector.

CORE_CONNECTOR_PROFILES.description: Connector used to update SYNTH NPC Dynamic Profiles. Recommend to use a Standard LLM.

CORE_CONNECTOR_WORLDKNOWLEDGE_CUSTOM.description: Connector used for the bounded explicit-request World Knowledge fallback. Deterministic local retrieval remains the default.

RELATIONSHIP_SYSTEM_ENABLED.description: Enable the Relationship Management System. When enabled, NPCs will dynamically form and update relationships based on conversations and events. Requires RELLLM_CONNECTOR to be configured.

RELLLM_CONNECTOR.description: Connector used for Relationship Management system. Analyzes and updates NPC relationships. Recommend to use a Fast LLM with low temperature (0.1-0.3) for consistent evaluations.

NEVER_CLEAR_RELATIONSHIP_DATA.description: Keep current NPC relationships when loading older saves. NPCs may remember later events. Off by default.

POWER_AWARENESS_ENABLED.description: NPCs will be aware of relative power levels (based on character level) and react appropriately to threats.

CLEAN_CONTEXT_FOCUS_CHAT_HISTORY.description: Context history length with only conversations. Ideally set it to 20-30.

model.description:
Must be JSON/Instruct type of Model!
FREE MODELS ARE NOT RECOMMENDED!

reasoning_model.description: Select True if this is a reasoning model and you want to remove CoT (text between 'think' tags).

fallback_models.description: List of fallback models to use when the main model returns an error. Comma-separated list.

PROVIDER.description: Leave blank unless you want to manually select providers from OpenRouter. Comma-separated case sensitive list.

providers_to_ignore.description: Providers to ignore. Comma-separated case sensitive list.

provider_quantizations.description: Quantization levels to filter by. Comma-separated case sensitive list. Values: int4,int8,fp4,fp6,fp8,fp16,bf16,fp32,unknown

provider_max_price_input.description: Use only providers that have lower input price per milion tokens. Zero to disable filter.

provider_max_price_output.description: Use only providers that have lower output price per milion tokens. Zero to disable filter.

ENFORCE_JSON.description: Will attempt to enforce dumb LLM's to stay in JSON format. Leave as default (TRUE), only works with specific models.

PREFILL_JSON.description: Will attempt to prefill the JSON AI response for some dumber LLM's. Leave as default (FALSE), only works with specific models.

MAX_TOKENS_MEMORY.description: No longer used. Use SUMMARY connector for memory tokens instead.

json_schema.description: Enable OpenRouter Json schema. Does not work with all models. You must set a provider that supports structured outputs. Requires ENFORCE_JSON to be true.

reasoning_model.description: Select True if this is a reasoning model and you want to remove CoT.

MAX_TOKENS_MEMORY.description: No longer used. Use SUMMARY connector for memory tokens instead.

json_schema.description: Enable OpenAI Json schema. Does not work with all OpenAI's models

MAX_TOKENS_MEMORY.description: Maximum tokens to generate when summarizing, diary entries, and dynamic profile updates.

url.description:
Kobold should be running on the same machine as DwemerDistro!
Must use your computers, not the DwemerDistro, IP Address.
Can be found by running the command 'ipconfig' in your CMD prompt.
Example: http://your-local-ip:8008

PREFILL_JSON.description: Will prefill JSON, which is useful for some AI models, and destroy others.

MAX_TOKENS_MEMORY.description: No longer used. Use SUMMARY connector for memory tokens instead.

newline_as_stopseq.description: A new line in the output that will be considered a stop sequence. Recommended to leave as default.

use_default_badwordsids.description: Unban End of Sentence (EOS) tokens. If set to false the LLM will stop generating when it detects an EOS token.

eos_token.description: EOS token LLM uses. Only works if use_default_badwordsids is enabled.

template.description: Prompt Format. Specified in the HuggingFace model card

grammar.description: Enforces use of JSON grammar. True to enforce (generation speed loss, but json format guaranteed). if false, the generation speed will be better but will depend on the model to produce valid JSON output.

url.description: Player2 should be running on the same machine as DwemerDistro! Will connect automatically so do not change the URL. Does not currently support Chat Assist/Creation.

TTSFUNCTION.description: Text-to-Speech service options. Used to generate AI NPC voice.

language.description: Language Model. Should be EN if using default installation

voiceid.description: Voice ID. Should be set automatically for most Vanilla Fallout 4 NPCs. Uses Fallout 4 VoiceType ID, e.g. femaleeventoned. Click the help/doc link for full list of voiceids!

url.description: Click [Host PC IP] to set the URL to point to xVASynth. Should be running on the same machine as DwemerDistro!

version.description: xVASynth version (e.g. 3.0 is default. Older models are 1.0 or 2.0)

endpoint.description: Manual for Zonos can be found here. Endpoint URL. Can be ran on : Vast.ai

model.description: Default profile only. Model to use.

dynamic_tones.description: Default profile only. Enhance emotional quality by requesting values from the LLM. If false, emotions will be determined by the LLM-selected mood.

voiceid.description: Generated voice file name. Works the same as SYNTH-XTTS voiceid and uses its voicelogic setting. Will only work with voices in your Voice Cache.

cfg_scale.description: CFG scale. Controls how closely the audio matches the sample voice. Higher numbers will be a closer match. [1.1 - 5]

cached_voice_path.description: Path to the sample audio stored in zonos. Leave as default; it is set automatically.

region.description: Region location of your API key

instructions.description: Control the voice of your generated audio with additional instructions. Does not work with tts-1 or tts-1-hd.

endpoint.description: Leave as is if using SYNTH XTTS. If you want to use a host-machine XTTS server then click[HOST PC IP]. [WSL IP] will set it back to point to SYNTH XTTS.

voiceid.description: Generated voice file name. Click the help link to go to XTTS management.

voicelogic.description:
Default profile only. Logic used for generating [TTS XTTSFASTAPI voiceid]
voicetype = NPC voicetype ID (FemaleAdult01)
name = NPC name (doc_mitchell)

PARALINGUISTIC_TAGS_ENABLED.description: Enable paralinguistic tags like [laugh], [sigh] for expressive TTS output.

PARALINGUISTIC_TAGS_PROMPT.description: Prompt snippet instructing the LLM to use paralinguistic tags. Added to system prompt when enabled.

PARALINGUISTIC_TAGS_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of supported paralinguistic tags (e.g., [laugh],[sigh],[gasp]). Tags are case-insensitive.

endpoint.description: Chatterbox endpoint. DwemerDistro uses dedicated port 8023. Click[HOST PC IP] or [WSL IP] to configure.

voiceid.description: Generated voice file name. Click the help link to go to voice management.

voicelogic.description:
Default profile only. Logic used for generating [TTS CHATTERBOX voiceid]
voicetype = NPC voicetype ID (FemaleAdult01)
name = NPC name (doc_mitchell)

PARALINGUISTIC_TAGS_ENABLED.description: Enable paralinguistic tags like [laugh], [sigh] for expressive TTS output.

PARALINGUISTIC_TAGS_PROMPT.description: Prompt snippet instructing the LLM to use paralinguistic tags. Added to system prompt when enabled.

PARALINGUISTIC_TAGS_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of supported paralinguistic tags (e.g., [laugh],[sigh],[gasp]). Tags are case-insensitive.

endpoint.description: OmniVoice endpoint. DwemerDistro default is 8021. Click[HOST PC IP] or [WSL IP] to configure.

voiceid.description: Generated voice file name. Use a VoiceID from the installed OmniVoice language library.

voicelogic.description:
Default profile only. Logic used for generating [TTS OMNIVOICE voiceid]
voicetype = NPC voicetype ID (FemaleAdult01)
name = NPC name (doc_mitchell)

endpoint.description: PocketTTS endpoint. Python PocketTTS uses dedicated port 8024; DwemerDistro audio.cpp uses 8086. The connector detects the API automatically from the endpoint. Click[HOST PC IP] or [WSL IP] to configure.

voiceid.description: Generated voice file name. Click the help link to go to voice management.

voicelogic.description:
Default profile only. Logic used for generating [TTS POCKETTTS voiceid]
voicetype = NPC voicetype ID (FemaleAdult01)
name = NPC name (doc_mitchell)

endpoint.description: Piper-TTS endpoint URL. The IP address of the machine where Piper-TTS is installed.

voiceid.description: MUST DOWNLOAD VOICES MANUALLY! CLICK HELP LINK FOR INSTRUCTIONS! Voice ID code. Model voices are stored in 'models' folder in .onnx files. Voice ID is the file name without extension.

length_scale.description: speaking time scale. Use a value over 1.0 to play slower, a value under 1.0 is faster.

noise_scale.description: speaking variability. Leave 0 to use voice model internal value. Experiment with values around 0.667

noise_w_scale.description: phoneme width variability. Leave 0 to use voice model internal value. Experiment with values around 0.8

speaker.description: Name of speaker for multi-speaker voices (if you have an .onnx voice file with multiple voices).

speaker_id.description: Speaker id for multi-speaker voices, overrides speaker name if used. 0 is default (first) speaker.

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice ID to speak with.

optimize_streaming_latency.description: Reduces response delay at some cost to quality and text handling. Use 0 for default behavior; higher values favor speed more aggressively.

model_id.description: ElevenLabs model to use for this connector. Use eleven_v3 if you want V3 enhancers or audio tags.

stability.description: Controls how consistent each generation sounds. Lower values are more expressive, while higher values are steadier and less varied.

similarity_boost.description: Controls how closely the output sticks to the selected voice. Higher values usually sound more like the source voice, but can reduce flexibility.

style.description: Adds extra stylization and exaggeration to the delivery. Higher values can sound more dramatic, but may increase latency.

speed.description: Adjusts the speaking rate of the generated audio. 1.0 is normal speed.

use_speaker_boost.description: Boosts resemblance to the original voice at a small latency cost. Ignored by eleven_v3.

apply_text_normalization.description: Controls whether numbers, dates, abbreviations, and similar text are rewritten before speech. Auto lets ElevenLabs decide, on always normalizes, and off keeps the raw text.

apply_language_text_normalization.description: Enables extra language-specific cleanup before synthesis. This is mainly useful for languages that need special text handling, such as Japanese.

v3_audio_tags.description: Optional Eleven v3 prompt tags added before the text, such as [whispers] or [curious]. Only used when model_id is eleven_v3.

API_KEY.description: Optional ElevenLabs API key setting. Prefer assigning an ElevenLabs API Badge to the connector instead.

voiceid.description: Voice file name. Works the same as SYNTH-XTTS voiceid. Will only work with voices in your Voice Cache. Voice will be automatically cloned to Cartesia when first used.

language.description: Language to use for TTS generation. Sonic 3 supports 42 languages.

model_id.description: Cartesia speech model. Sonic 3 and newer support request-local speed and optional English emotional guidance. Earlier models retain the legacy request format.

speed.description: Speaking speed; Sonic 3 maps these choices to numeric guidance from 0.6 to 1.5.

use_emotions.description: Send the current line's supported mood as English emotional guidance on Sonic 3 and newer. Disabled by default; unknown or automatic moods use transcript prosody.

workspace.description: Inworld workspace ID (required for voice cloning). Format: workspaces/{workspace} or just the workspace ID.

voiceid.description: Voice file name. Works the same as SYNTH-XTTS voiceid. Will only work with voices in your Voice Cache. Voice will be automatically cloned to Inworld when first used.

fallback_voice_id.description: Optional existing Inworld voice ID used when an actor sample is unavailable. Use the full workspace__voice ID.

language.description: Language to use for TTS generation. Uses BCP-47 regional language codes.

model_id.description: Inworld model to use. inworld-tts-1 is the standard model, inworld-tts-1.5-max is the higher quality model.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-2). Higher values make output more random. Default: 1.0

TTSFUNCTION_PLAYER.description: Text-to-Speech service options. Used to generate your voice.

TTSFUNCTION_PLAYER_VOICE.description: VoiceID to use for the player character.

TTSFUNCTION_PLAYER_VOICE_ID.description: Speaker ID to select a voice from multi-voice model.

TTSFUNCTION_PLAYER_LANGUAGE.description: Overrides the TTS language for the player character.

PLAYER_RESPEECH.description: Allows the AI to rewrite player speech with Chat Assist & Creation modes.

STTFUNCTION.description: Speech-to-Text service options. Transcribes your voice to text.

VISUAL_CONTEXT_SCENE_TTL_MINUTES.description: Minutes that an unlocked PipVision capture remains available to prompts. Locked location captures do not expire.

VISUAL_CONTEXT_PROMPT_MAX_CHARS.description: Maximum PipVision description characters injected into a prompt.

PIPVISION_IMAGE_QUALITY.description: JPEG quality used when SYNTH Server stores PipVision screenshots. Range: 45-95.

PIPVISION_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Maximum time allowed for the PipVision image model request. Range: 10-180 seconds.

profanity.description:
Specifies how to handle profanity in recognition results. Accepted values are:
MASKED, which replaces profanity with asterisks.
REMOVED, which removes all profanity from the result.
RAW, which includes profanity in the result.

URL.description: Local whisper endpoint. Leave as is if you installed localwhisper through the Distro.

FORMFIELD.description: Form field name for audio file. Sometimes needed to change to file to use another shiper implementations

MODEL.description: Gemini model. 2.5 Flash recommended for best speed and quality.

API_KEY.description: Inworld API key. Can also be managed from API Badge under Inworld.

MODEL_ID.description: Model identifier in provider/model format, e.g. groq/whisper-large-v3.

LANGUAGE.description: Language code in BCP-47 format, e.g. en-US. Leave blank for auto-detect.

ENABLED.description: Enable long-term memory recall. The system injects relevant memory summaries into AI context for responses.

TXTAI_URL.description: MiniMe/TXT2VEC service base URL. Use http://127.0.0.1:8082 for the local DwemerDistro service, or set the reachable URL of a remote service.

USE_TEXT2VEC.description: Use TXT2VEC to create embeddings for memories. These are more accurate than keywords.

MEMORY_TIME_DELAY.description: Time in minutes to delay before using a memory in a prompt. Used to avoid pushing recent dialogues as memories.

MEMORY_CONTEXT_SIZE.description: The amount of the most relevant memory records that will be injected into the prompt.

AUTO_CREATE_SUMMARYS.description: Will combine individual memory logs into larger ones. Is more accurate for memory recollection but will use up more tokens. If using koboldcpp, use the multiuser mode to avoid locking.

AUTO_CREATE_SUMMARY_INTERVAL.description: Time frame used to pack summary data. Each point is about 0.24 in-game hours. Examples: 5 = 1.2 in-game hours | 10 = 2.4 in-game hours | 50 = 12 in-game hours

AUTO_CREATE_SUMMARY_MIN_EVENTS.description: Minimum number of events required in a packed time bucket before creating a global memory summary. Default: 5

INDIVIDUAL_MEMORY_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD.description: How many global memory summaries involving an NPC are required before creating one NPC-scoped individual memory summary. Default: 3

MEMORY_BIAS_A.description: From 0 (never) to 100 (always). Minimal distance to offer memory.

MEMORY_BIAS_B.description: From 0 (never) to 100 (always). Minimal distance to offer and endorse memory.

ADD_TIME_MARKS.description: Add timestamps to the context logs. Helps with memory recollection.
